title: Multi Site Randomized Feasibility Trial (n=60) of Adapted Early Postpartum PTSD Interventions
official: Phase 2. Multi Site Randomized Feasibility Trial (n=60) of Adapted Early Postpartum PTSD Interventions
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the feasibility, acceptability, and preliminary effectiveness of two early interventions, Written Exposure Therapy (WET) and Capnometry-Guided Breathing Intervention (CGRI), for reducing post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) symptoms following childbirth, compared with usual care.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18
* Delivered a live infant within 5 days
* Severe maternal morbidity or infant admitted to NICU
* PTSD Checklist for DSM-5 (PCL-5) ≥28
* English-speaking
* Able to consent and participate

Exclusion Criteria:

* Active psychosis or mania
* Current suicidal crisis
* Current suicidal intent or plan

sites.f: University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences
